Sorbet Hour | Gift box recipe

Mandarin: 3 × 100 mL
Raspberry: 1 × 100 mL
White guava: 2 × 100 mL
Total: 6 cups × 100 mL = 600 mL

Ingredients
Mandarin — Mandarin pulp, mandarin juice, water, cane sugar, lemon juice.
Raspberry — Raspberries, water, cane sugar, lemon juice.
White guava — White guava purée, water, cane sugar, lime juice.

Allergens
The concept recipes use no added milk, eggs, peanuts or tree nuts. Shared equipment may come into contact with milk, peanuts and tree nuts.

Storage
The intended storage temperature is −18 °C or below. Take out just what you’ll serve and follow the label on the actual product.

A seasonal sorbet brand concept. The recipe is created in this page for offline use and sharing.

live-aeriform-en.captureTiming: GPU submittedAt identifies the readback submission near the start of the 100ms interval; the composite is captured after it. They are paired by control state, not claimed to be the same submitted frame. Pause comparisons use only composite captures with no intervening animation-clock advancement.

simulation.note: Evolving particles are allowed to keep distinct positions after a form is restored; shape return requires independent temporal review, not pixel identity.

controlAcceptance.reason: A continuing particle simulation can change pixels without a working form selector. Equal-window differences are diagnostic only.
controlAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Same-candidate dedicated desktop/mobile original composites and GPU captures: motion helix, digital ribbon, restored identity ring; non-author semantic verdict in view.semanticControls and coherence.

diagnosticContribution.method: Temporarily hide the paused canvas; not a native product action

diagnosticCapture.note: Post-control diagnostic and full-page stills use native pause; temporal acceptance uses the separately recorded original sequences.
